g.text: Offline image inspection: known wall, saved BP and online-selected candidate
Candidates are chosen solely by saved corrected online d_cal; exact ties use lexical method names. Continuous known truth enters only the offline first column.
BP and candidate use the saved full 48×32 contrast/conductivity grids; display sampling is 256×192, with calibration-query air imposed pointwise. No reconstruction-success claim.
